reviews.title: Deep sleeper approved
reviews.text: I’ve been struggling to wake up for some time now I’ve tried numerous alarms, using multiple phones, heavy duty alarm clocks off Amazon, even the wife. This is the only alarm to get me out of bed, make sure your phone is on full blast and choose a wake up method that gets your blood flowing I always do the pushups and make it a decent number not some low number you’ll just go back to sleep after. The only sucky part is having to pay I do wish it was a bit cheaper but it works!

reviews.title: AMAZING
reviews.text: I would just like to say that this app has been SUPER helpful! I have tried tons of different apps, alarms and even the vibrating watch and nothing helped really to get out of bed until this app! I work long hours and get home and take care of my family so when I can sleep, I sleep hard and it’s so difficult to wake up without wanting to hit snooze if I even wake up to do that. My legs are getting more toned having to do squats first thing in the morning and I just saw tonight looking at other tasks there were and they included a Bible Verse option?! I LOVE THAT. This app is worth the money! 10/10 ☺️
